headline: SBB Major Owner Salén Buys D-Shares Following Failed Redemption Vote
summary: Major shareholder Erik Salén acquired D-shares in Swedish property firm SBB, citing a significant valuation discount shortly after shareholders rejected a company plan to repurchase and redeem the shares.
why: Swedish real estate companies face ongoing refinancing challenges, and shareholder decisions on hybrid equity affect capital structure stability.

impacts.name: Samhällsbyggnadsbolaget i Norden AB
impacts.why: Erik Salén initiated purchases of SBB D-shares after the shareholder rejection of the buyback and redemption plan.
